def find_path(tree, target):
    path=[]
    while tree is not None:
        value,left,right=tree;path.append(value)
        if value==target:return path
        tree=left if target<value else right
    return []

steps.text: Set path to an empty list.
Repeat while tree is not None.
Set (value, left, right) to tree. Append value to path.
Check whether value equals target. Return path.
Set tree to left if target is less than value; otherwise right.
